decisions.reason: The existing message-595 MODIFY already updates the FAQ to state that every successful primary mint produces one commission and one ticket, including random allocation for no-code mints and exclusion of secondary sales.
The Mission-page statement that successful referrals provide tickets remains valid and does not claim that referral mints are the only source of tickets.

The existing message-595 MODIFY already establishes one commission and one Small Block ticket per successful primary mint, with secondary-market sales excluded; the random-recipient rule was already present.
The existing MODIFY establishes one ticket per primary mint but leaves stale referral-only entry semantics and a no-referral allocation containing both Small and eliminated Big Block ticket types.
